notes: The second to before all the cities is read as the distributed scope of the same supplied preposition that reaches the verb's first object (rule 25) rather than as a second added word.

Competing reading: read מִבְצַר־צֹר as a goal accusative rather than the verb's direct object, which would put the first to on that noun under rule 33 (as rule 33's own to your mountain does) and the second on כֹּל as the word opening the coordinated phrase. Rule 33 directs that only what governs the noun in the Hebrew tells the two apart, and MACULA's clause structure is not in the packet, so the valency reading was retained.
